derivation: The checkpoint's parent obligation is WAITING on an exact existing child pass whose own obligations are still OPEN. LIFE-019 admits that waiting variant because the child-pass identity, the outer prefix, the obligation inventory and the acyclic nesting all agree, and because the pass is incomplete the rule that rejects an ACTIVE state holding an all-DISCHARGED pass does not apply. LIFE-007 then governs the proposal itself: current accepted authority and no shared budget give PERMITTED with an empty reason set and exactly one permit created, with the child occurrence moving to PERMITTED. PAR-001 keeps the parent obligation WAITING with its child-pass reference retained, because only the child join resumes it and no obligation in that pass has completed.

obligations.text: Card issuance requires the declared business authority and shared committed plus unsettled USD exposure at most 1000 over the trailing 24 hours.
